title: Graduate Analyst Programme - Financial Services
description:
About Baringa 

Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.

The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence - all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.

Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly - all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.

Certified as a  Great Place to Work around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the Financial Times in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by Forbes for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.

Our Graduate Analyst Programme

Our Graduate Analyst role offers the opportunity to start and grow your career at Baringa. As a permanent member of our team from day one, you'll work on a variety of real client and internal projects, develop valuable skills, and make a meaningful contribution from the outset.

You'll work alongside experienced consultants, building both your technical and professional capabilities through structured learning, hands-on experience, and ongoing development opportunities. Along the way, you'll build relationships across the business, collaborate with colleagues from different teams and sectors, and contribute to work that makes a real impact.

If you're a recent graduate looking to kick-start your career, Baringa offers a supportive and collaborative environment where you can develop your skills, gain practical experience, and build a successful long-term future with us.

We're looking for Graduate Analysts to join our Financial Services practice.

Financial Services is being reinvented. AI is transforming how businesses operate, customer expectations are rising and established players are under pressure to grow, innovate and perform at pace. That’s where Baringa comes in. Across Banking, Capital Markets and Insurance, we work alongside senior leaders at some of the world’s leading financial institutions to tackle the challenges that matter most. From unlocking new sources of growth and reimagining how businesses operate, to harnessing AI and responding to rapidly changing markets, we help turn complex problems into meaningful, lasting impact. You’ll bring together bold strategic thinking, analytical rigour, an AI-native mindset and a bias for action - helping clients move from ambition to results. It’s challenging, fast-moving work at the intersection of strategy, technology and transformation, with the opportunity to make an impact from the very start of your career.

Desired Skills: Tech and Data (AI) Experience (where applicable), Structured problem solving, Data analysis, Digital and AI literacy, Team collaboration and personal communication, Adaptability, Commercial and financial curiosity.

Desired Degrees: STEM, Business, Politics, Law, Geography

title: Counsel, Telecommunications (Starlink)
description:
SpaceXAI’s mission is to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge.  Our team is small, highly motivated, and focused on engineering excellence. This organization is for individuals who appreciate challenging themselves and thrive on curiosity. We operate with a flat organizational structure. All employees are expected to be hands-on and to contribute directly to the company’s mission. Leadership is given to those who show initiative and consistently deliver excellence. Work ethic and strong prioritization skills are important. All employees are expected to have strong communication skills. They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

Starlink, our revolutionary satellite constellation, is delivering low-latency broadband internet worldwide. As a Telecommunications Counsel, you will help the business understand and navigate applicable laws and regulations in Europe and Africa.

RESPONSIBILITIES: 

• Advise the Starlink team on the laws, regulations, and policies that impact our business in Europe and parts of Africa, particularly laws relating to telecommunications and internet services

• Analyze legal and regulatory risks and communicate them to the business and technical teams to enable sound compliance decisions and to support telecommunications and other business licensing in Europe and Africa

• Monitor legal and policy developments related to the Starlink business

• Interface with governmental agencies periodically concerning regulatory, consumer protection and law enforcement matters 

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• 5+ years of professional experience with regulatory compliance matters in the telecommunications industry related to broadband and/or satellite services

• Juris Doctor, Bachelor of Laws or equivalent degree from an accredited institution

• Active license to practice law in at least one jurisdiction

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Fluency in French and/or Portuguese

• Knowledge of telecommunications business and regulatory issues outside of the U.S.

• Prior experience managing legal issues for a high-growth multinational company

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• This position is based in London, England and requires being onsite - remote and hybrid work will not be considered

• Must be available to work extended hours and weekends as needed 

SpaceXAI is an equal opportunity employer. For details on data processing, view our Recruitment Privacy Notice .

title: New Business Account Executive - Unleashed Software
description:
We’re looking for people to join the Access family, who share our passion for believing in better, and who will help us continue to grow.
Love Work. Love Life. Be You. - is central to our success and how we give our customers the freedom to do more of what's important to them.
What does Access offer you?
We offer a blended approach to office working, encouraging you to collaborate and connect in one of our thriving offices. We deliver on what we say, taking the development of our people seriously. We’ll work with you to progress your success plan and provide opportunities to accelerate your career.
On top of a competitive salary, our wellbeing days taking you to 25 days leave a year and a health contribution, you’ll also be able to choose from a range of benefits to suit you. We’re an organisation that likes to give back, so you’ll also have three charity days allocated to support a cause that matters to you.

About you:

You enjoy owning the full sales journey and seeing the impact of your work from first conversation through to close. You’re naturally curious about how product‑based businesses run and like digging into real operational challenges before suggesting a solution. You’re comfortable working remotely, managing your own day, and you take pride in running a tidy pipeline. At Access, you’ll have the support, coaching and inbound demand to do your best work, while still having the freedom to build your own momentum.

Day to day, you will:

• Manage a mix of inbound and self‑sourced opportunities, taking each one through a clear and structured sales process.

• Run thoughtful discovery calls and product demos that link Unleashed’s inventory management software to real business problems.

• Build relationships with founders, finance leads and operations teams, making sure you understand how decisions are made.

• Own your deals through to close, keeping Salesforce up to date and handing over smoothly to onboarding and customer success.

Your skills and experiences might also include:

• Experience in full‑cycle B2B sales, including prospecting, discovery, demos and commercial conversations.

• Experience selling software to small or medium‑sized businesses, particularly in manufacturing, wholesale or distribution.

• Familiarity with structured sales approaches, such as MEDDPICC or SPIN, to qualify and progress opportunities.

• Confidence talking about technology ecosystems, including accounting software, e‑commerce platforms or integrations.

What are we all about?
The Access Group is one of the largest UK-headquartered business management software providers. It provides solutions that empower more than 160,000 small and mid-sized organisations in commercial and non-profit sectors across Europe, USA and APAC, giving every employee the freedom to do more of what's important. Its innovative cloud solutions and integrated AI software experience across multiple Access products transform how business technology is used.
With over 9,300 talented individuals driving innovation and customer excellence, we’re shaping the future of work. And we want you to be part of it. At Access, people are at the heart of everything we do . We’re committed to creating an inclusive, high-performing culture where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to thrive. If you’re excited about this role - even if your experience doesn’t tick every box - you might be exactly who we’re looking for.
We believe in equality for all and the transformative power of diversity. So why not join our vibrant team, where you can love what you do, love how you live, and most importantly, be authentically you?
Let’s make a difference together.
Love Work. Love Life. Be You.

• Support repeatable deployment of firmware and software updates to lab hardware, test benches, and fielded units

• Build release-assurance workflows that collect test evidence, generate release notes and software bills of materials, version release artifacts, and maintain traceability between source code, builds, test results, and deployed software

title: Lead Data Engineer
description:
Lead Data Engineer
About us:
At Fullbay , our mission is simple - to create safer roads for our families and yours. As leaders in the heavy-duty repair industry, we power shops with technology that helps them run smarter and more efficiently. As an AI-First company, we invite artificial intelligence to eliminate friction, spark innovation, and drive efficiencies in every conversation- for our teams and our customers. Fullbay is the number one cloud-based shop management software for commercial repair shops and is growing fast. This is an exciting opportunity to join a high-performing team and help shape the next phase of growth for the company.
Position Overview:
The Lead Data Engineer owns Fullbay 's data platform end to end. Fullbay runs a Snowflake data warehouse that serves organizational reporting across two live products and acts as the primary read plane for AI agents. This role owns the architecture of that platform, builds it out hands-on, and holds the authority to set standards and revise the design as the business changes.
At its core this is an enablement role. Business users and AI agents increasingly self-serve against Fullbay data, and the Lead Data Engineer is what makes that self-service trustworthy, through certified metric definitions, a well-governed semantic layer, and disciplined platform standards. The role reports directly to the VP of IT with the charter to set data standards company-wide.
The Right Wrench for the Job
Every heavy-duty shop runs on one set of specs. Torque values, part numbers, and service intervals only work when the tech, the service writer, and the parts counter all read from the same manual. When two people have two different numbers for the same bolt, the truck comes back. That's this role, but for the numbers Fullbay runs on: the definitions behind every report, for two live products and for the AI agents that now read the data as readily as people do.
You're the right fit if you've owned a production data platform and know the difference between a metric that's documented and one that's trusted. You can declare a grain and defend it in the morning, ship tested SQL through version control by noon, and tell an executive no, with the reasoning, before the end of the day. You treat documentation as the deliverable, because you may be the only person who knows how something works, and you're curious about what it takes to make company data something agents can rely on.
This isn't the role for someone who wants to build reports on request, or who needs a data team, a finished design, and a scoped backlog to lean on. If your instinct is to say yes to every ask and sort out the definition later, this isn't your shop. But if you're the kind of person who will set the standard, hold the line on it, and write it down so the next person can pick it up without a phone call, we'd like to talk.
Primary Duties & Responsibilities:

• Certified Definitions & Semantic Layer: Own the metric and entity definitions the whole company reports from and serve as the final arbiter when functions disagree on a definition. Keep documentation current enough that a business user finds the right answer without needing to ask - this is the center of the role, not a component of it.

• Gold Layer Ownership: Build and extend Fullbay ’s gold layer hands-on, writing SQL and transformation code in version control with automated tests.

• Identity Resolution: Own identity resolution across our Classic, Next, and Salesforce platforms, including crosswalk logic, survivorship rules, and platform-of-record determination over time. A permanent responsibility, not a one-time migration task.

• Snowflake Platform Ownership: Own Snowflake’s role hierarchy and grants, row access and masking policies, warehouse sizing, and cost attribution and spend.

• Agent Enablement: Design curated access paths for AI agents as first-class data consumers, including per-agent identities and grants, a registration pattern, and a retention po

title: Deputy AML Manager - Belgium

At bunq, we're more than just a bank, we're transforming how people experience banking across Europe. Our users deserve to bank like locals, no matter where they are. We started Belgium with local IBANs, but we're now upgrading to full-branch status, which means taking on direct regulatory standing, deeper compliance obligations, and new accountability to Belgium's NBB (National Bank of Belgium) and financial regulators.

As AML Manager Belgium, your mission is to lead Belgium through this compliance transition, ensuring we move seamlessly from our lighter vIBAN model to full-branch operations while maintaining regulatory trust and operational excellence. You'll be the accountable person who owns Belgium's entire compliance footprint, AML/CFT operational readiness, integrity-risk assessment (SIRA), and financial-crime reporting (FIU), all operating at full-branch regulatory standards.
Take Ownership
As AML Belgium, you'll own:

• Transition Belgium to full-branch compliance model, migrate from vIBAN-era compliance systems to full-branch operations, ensuring seamless readiness for NBB oversight and maintaining zero regulatory findings during the upgrade.

• Own Belgium's SIRA, AML/CFT, and FIU obligations end-to-end, establish Belgium-localized SIRA integrity-risk assessments, AML/CFT gap analysis, and FIU financial-crime reporting, using AI-first mechanisms to deliver what traditional banks staff with a local team.

• Prepare Belgium's AML program for regulatory inspection readiness, maintain audit trails, evidence documentation, and control testing for NBB oversight.

What You'll Work on Right Away

• Full-Branch Compliance Readiness Audit : Conduct a comprehensive audit of Belgium's current compliance posture under vIBAN model, identify gaps for full-branch requirements (NBB, FSMA, Ombudsfin), and deliver a remediation roadmap with specific AI-driven solutions.

• Belgium-Localized SIRA & FIU Systems : Design and implement Belgium-specific SIRA integrity-risk controls and FIU financial-crime reporting mechanisms, using AI tooling to automate what possible and keeping humans in the loop for judgment calls and escalations.

Do You Have What It Takes?

• Deep Belgian AML/CFT & regulatory expertise - You understand NBB requirements, FSMA rules, local banking regulations, and their practical application; you can translate Belgian regulatory language into operational compliance controls.

• Proven ownership of compliance programs end-to-end - You've built or scaled a compliance program (not just supported one), managing operational readiness, risk assessment, and regulatory reporting as the accountable person.

• Proven ability to manage AML inspections and regulatory audits, preparing evidence, audit trails, and control documentation for regulator scrutiny.

• AI-first operating mindset - You're comfortable building compliance operations using AI and automation (not traditional local headcount), and you can design mechanisms that let AI handle routine workflows while you focus on exceptions and regulatory judgment.

• Fluency in Dutch, French, or both + English - You can navigate Belgian regulatory communication and engage with local stakeholders in their language; English fluency for bunq-wide collaboration.

title: QC AML Investigations
description:
Description
We are seeking an experienced AML Quality Control (QC) / Financial Crime professional with strong expertise in anti-money laundering regulations, financial crime typologies, investigative processes, and case quality review.
The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience conducting and/or reviewing AML investigations, assessing suspicious activity, identifying investigative gaps, and ensuring cases meet regulatory and internal quality standards. Experience with AML case management platforms such as Actimize, Oracle, SAS, or Verafin is highly preferred.
We are particularly interested in candidates who can discuss their AML QC review experience, challenges encountered, and specific use cases or examples demonstrating their ability to identify issues and improve investigative quality.
Key Qualifications

•
AML Expertise: Strong understanding of AML regulations, financial crime typologies, red flags, and associated risks.

•
AML QC Experience: Hands-on experience performing quality control reviews of AML investigations , including identifying gaps, inconsistencies, and opportunities for improvement.

•
Case Management Platforms: Proficiency with at least one AML case management or transaction monitoring platform, such as Actimize, Oracle, SAS, Verafin , or similar tools.

•
Regulatory Knowledge: Strong knowledge of AML compliance frameworks, regulatory requirements, and investigative standards.

•
SAR Experience: Demonstrated experience drafting, reviewing, and/or submitting Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs) .

•
Investigative & Analytical Skills: Ability to analyze complex transactional and behavioral data, identify suspicious patterns, and determine appropriate investigative actions.

•
Risk Assessment: Strong understanding of customer and account risk factors, including sanctions, fraud, terrorist financing, bribery and corruption, and insider threats.

•
Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly document investigative findings and communicate recommendations.

•
Attention to Detail: Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy, consistency, and regulatory compliance.

Key Responsibilities

• Conduct and/or perform QC reviews of end-to-end AML investigations across cases of varying complexity.

• Review investigations involving potential money laundering, terrorist financing, fraud, sanctions violations, and other financial crime risks .

• Assess whether investigative conclusions are supported by appropriate evidence and whether cases meet established regulatory and internal standards.

• Evaluate whether investigators have applied reasonable grounds to suspect (RGS) appropriately when determining whether suspicious activity should be escalated or reported.

• Perform holistic reviews of customer relationships, considering relevant risk factors such as:

• AML risk

• Sanctions exposure

• Fraud

• Bribery and corruption

• Terrorist financing

• Insider threats

• Customer and transactional risk

• Review investigative narratives, supporting documentation, disposition decisions, and SAR recommendations for completeness, accuracy, and consistency.

• Identify investigative gaps, process deficiencies, recurring errors, and quality trends , and provide actionable feedback.

• Utilize AML case management and transaction monitoring platforms to document, manage, review, and resolve cases.

• Draft and/or review SARs in accordance with regulatory requirements and internal policies.

• Analyze transactional, customer, and behavioral data to identify suspicious activity and emerging financial crime patterns.

• Partner with investigators, compliance teams, and other stakeholders to improve investigative quality and consistency .

• Support enhancements to AML investigative procedures, quality standards, and controls.

• Ensure all investigations and QC reviews remain aligned with AML policies, procedures, regulatory expectations, and industry best practices .

You’ll join a small, cross-functional engineering team building products at the cutting edge of sport and technology. With the direction set and plenty still to be built, you’ll have the autonomy to shape solutions, make important technical decisions and see your work make a real difference.

THE ROLE

You’ll own computer vision on the device, taking detection and tracking models and making them work reliably on consumer Android phones and tablets.

That means much more than getting a model to run. You’ll optimise and profile inference for real-world hardware, balancing performance with accuracy across different devices, lighting conditions and environments. You’ll work close to the camera capture pipeline, where frame timing, exposure and device behaviour can all affect the quality of the output.

Your challenge is to ensure that the data produced on a mobile device is accurate, reliable and trusted by the wider tracking system.

You’ll work closely with mobile, backend, computer vision and machine learning engineers, with the freedom to own both your technical approach and its implementation. We also embrace AI-augmented and AI-delegated development as part of how we work, enabling a small team to build and iterate at pace.

This is an opportunity to solve genuinely challenging engineering problems, influence how on-device vision is built and help establish the foundations for a technology that can change how sport is experienced and analysed.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

- Own on-device inference: Design and implement Android inference solutions that meet demanding accuracy, latency and performance requirements.

- Build the native Android vision layer: Develop and maintain C++ components using the Android NDK, alongside JNI bindings that connect them to our Kotlin application.

- Optimise models for mobile: Convert, quantise, profile and optimise detection and tracking models, exploring techniques such as pruning, graph optimisation and operator-level improvements.

- Solve real-world camera challenges: Work close to the capture pipeline, understanding how frame timing, exposure and camera behaviour influence model performance.

- Make accuracy measurable: Build validation tools and measurement processes that demonstrate performance against ground truth in real-world conditions.

- Engineer for real devices: Account for thermal constraints, battery consumption, hardware differences and the unpredictable conditions encountered in the field.

- Collaborate on model improvements: Work with our computer vision and machine learning specialists to identify, prototype and evaluate improvements to model performance.

- Shape technical decisions: Help determine what should run on-device and what should run elsewhere, bringing clear reasoning and an understanding of technical trade-offs.

- Build production-quality software: Write maintainable, testable and reliable code that meets the team's engineering standards.

- Work across disciplines: Communicate clearly with mobile application, back

title: Head of People Operations (m/f/d)
description:
ÜBER BUENA

Buena (backed by GV) macht alles rund um Immobilien so einfach und transparent wie den Kauf eines ETFs. Ob Suchen, Kaufen oder Finanzieren einer Wohnung. Wir tun das, indem wir Hausverwaltungen in ganz Deutschland übernehmen und in Technologieunternehmen verwandeln. In den vergangenen drei Jahren sind wir mit weniger als 25 Vollzeitmitarbeitern im HQ zur drittgrößten Hausverwaltung Deutschlands geworden.

ÜBER DIE ROLLE

Als Head of People Operations baust du das operative HR-Fundament für unsere bald mehr als 1.000 Mitarbeitenden im Berliner HQ und unseren deutschlandweiten Portfoliounternehmen.

Wir wachsen monatlich durch Zukäufe von Hausverwaltungen. Damit treffen unterschiedliche Verträge, Datenbestände und Arbeitsweisen aufeinander. Du sorgst dafür, dass daraus verlässliche Personalprozesse entstehen, die mit jeder weiteren Übernahme funktionieren.

Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf Personio, korrekten Mitarbeiterdaten, standardisierten HR-Prozessen und der Bearbeitung konkreter Personal- und Arbeitsrechtsfälle. Du entwirfst die Abläufe, setzt sie selbst um und verantwortest, dass sie im Alltag funktionieren. Bei Kündigungen, Vertragsfragen und Konflikten bist du ein kompetenter Sparringspartner für unsere Geschäftsführer und Führungskräfte und bindest bei Bedarf Legal oder externe Rechtsberatung ein.

Führungskräfteentwicklung, Performance Reviews sowie die Gestaltung von Salary Bands und Benefits liegen bei Operations und den verantwortlichen Führungskräften.

DEINE VERANTWORTLICHKEITEN

- Du verantwortest Personio und unsere Mitarbeiterdaten. Personio läuft bereits deutschlandweit. Du entwickelst die Konfiguration, Berechtigungen und Workflows weiter und sorgst dafür, dass die Daten vollständig, aktuell und belastbar sind.

- Du integrierst neue Gesellschaften in unsere People Operations. Du prüfst vorhandene Daten und Prozesse, klärst Unstimmigkeiten und überführst neue Portfoliounternehmen in unsere Systeme und Standards.

- Du baust wiederholbare HR-Prozesse und setzt sie um. Von Vertragserstellung und Onboarding über Vertragsänderungen und Beförderungen bis zum Offboarding definierst du klare Zuständigkeiten, Freigaben und Kontrollen.

- Du begleitest konkrete arbeitsrechtliche Fälle. Du klärst Sachverhalte, berätst unsere Geschäftsführer und Führungskräfte zu möglichen nächsten Schritten und steuerst die Umsetzung gemeinsam mit den zuständigen Entscheidern und Rechtsberatern.

- Du sicherst die Qualität unserer Payroll-Daten. Du sorgst dafür, dass relevante Änderungen korrekt und rechtzeitig bei den Verantwortlichen für die Abrechnung ankommen, und klärst Abweichungen.

- Du verbesserst das System hinter dem Einzelfall. Wiederkehrende Probleme übersetzt du in bessere Vorlagen, klare Abläufe und passende Automatisierungen. Mit operativem Reporting machst du Datenlücken, offene Vorgänge und Integrationsfortschritte sichtbar.

DU PASST, WENN DU

- bereits operative HR-Verantwortung für mehrere Hundert Mitarbeitende übernommen hast, idealerweise über mehrere Gesellschaften oder Standorte hinweg.

- HR-Prozesse selbst aufgebaut, eingeführt und anschließend im laufenden Betrieb verantwortet hast.

- Personio oder ein vergleichbares HR-System eigenständig konfiguriert hast und dich mit Datenmigration, Berechtigungen, Workflows und Datenqualität auskennst.

- fundierte Kenntnisse im deutschen Arbeitsrecht und praktische Erfahrung mit anspruchsvollen Personalmaßnahmen, insbesondere Kündigungen und Konfliktfällen, mitbringst.

- erkennst, welche Fälle du eigenständig bearbeiten kannst und wann du rechtliche Unterstützung hinzuziehen musst.

- auch bei unvollständigen Informationen klare Prioritäten setzt und Vorgänge zuverlässig bis zum Abschluss steuerst.

- Erfahrung in einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen mitbringst, beispielsweise einem VC-finanzierten Startup, einem PE-finanzierten Unternehmen oder einem Unternehmen mit vielen Zukäufen.

- Deutsch auf C2-Niveau sprichst.

Job Location Type: Remote
Job Contract Type: Part time

We’re building a world of health around every individual - shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger - helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.
Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Per Diem Clinician (Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant) to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.
You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.
Job highlights
The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.
In this role, you will:

• Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

• Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

• Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

• Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

• Conduct virtual visits as needed

• Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:
As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.
Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
"I love seeing health plan members at home. You get a better picture of their health when you see where they live.” - Erica R., PA
“At Signify Health, we have the time to help people and to truly listen to their questions and concerns. We can help guide them so they can take better care of themselves. We really can make a change in communities.” - Ali B., NP
“I like how Signify Health manages my experience. I’m just doing the clinician part of my job without all the administrative responsibilities. I have the time to provide education so people have a better understanding of their health. I can answer their questions without rushing out the door.” - Andrew K., PA
Per diem employees qualify for:

• Hourly base rate, plus additional incentive structure (i.e., per visit completed, other incentives may apply)

• Malpractice insurance coverage (during Signify Health-related activities)

• Supplies and other perks

Required & Preferred Qualifications (NPs and PAs)

• Active, unrestricted license(s) in coverage area(s)

• Board certification (required)

• Multi-state licenses (preferred)

title: Principal Engineer - Core Cloud Platform
description:
About AlphaSense: 

AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents - including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit www.alpha-sense.com . Come join us.

About the Role: 

The Core Cloud Platform team is responsible for AlphaSense's entire cloud infrastructure, including AWS account management, networking, data storages, and Kubernetes clusters. We build the underlying platform that supports hundreds of services and is used by over 400 globally distributed engineers.

We're scaling into a cell-based architecture, and the number of cells we run is growing fast, taking our Kubernetes footprint from dozens of clusters toward hundreds. That takes the platform in three directions at once: infrastructure configuration becomes a first-class layer with its own lifecycle, independent of application code; provisioning a new cell becomes a days-long automated operation rather than a multi-week effort; and cross-cell control points become standard, reusable, and consistent everywhere.

This is a Principal Engineer role with real breadth within the cloud platform. You'll set the architectural roadmap for our cloud, Kubernetes, and storage platform as it scales with AlphaSense's growth, and take dedicated ownership of the cloud-side configuration and Helm chart layer that every service depends on. Data storages are a critical part of this surface, and we're looking for genuine depth there.

It requires a deep cloud of both operational and software development skills, the ability to lead ambitious technical programmes, and the credibility to set direction with Engineering leaders and very senior engineers across dozens of teams.

We're looking for someone who genuinely embraces AI tooling in their day-to-day work, appreciates the productivity value it brings, and is motivated to make our infrastructure ever-more AI friendly.

What You’ll Do:  

• Own the architectural roadmap for our cloud, Kubernetes, and storage platform

• Own cloud-side configuration and the Helm chart layer for Cloud Core

• Build the cell registry and automate provisioning to take new cell setup from weeks to days

• Design the cross-cell gate mechanism as the reusable standard checkpoint across every cell

• Own, operate and evolve our Cloud and Kubernetes platform, including our data storage layers

• Make operations (upgrades, patching, lifecycle management) routine across hundreds of clusters

• Continuously improve the security, reliability, cost efficiency and performance of our infrastructure

• Champion standards and drive initiatives to promote uniformisation and eliminate duplication

• Enable truly self-service and agentic workflow patterns that support a Build it - Own it model

• Build tooling and AI powered integrations that reduce the cognitive load in cloud 

• Architect, design and implement simple and maintainable solutions

Who You Are:

• Extremely experienced in Kubernetes and its various components, containerisation and AWS cloud

• Proven track record of running Kubernetes and Cloud based production SaaS systems at scale

• Experience operating Kubernetes as a large fleet with hundreds of clusters

• Strong knowledge of data storages across SQL, MongoDB, ClickH

Welo Global’s five brands-Welocalize (multilingual content and localization services for global enterprises), Park IP (intellectual property and patent translation services for law firms and corporate legal teams), Welo Life Sciences (regulated language and compliance-aligned content solutions for pharmaceutical, biotech, and medical device organizations), Adapt (multilingual performance-led digital marketing agency), and Welo Data (multilingual data generation, evaluation, and human data infrastructure for AI systems)-serve distinct customer segments with purpose-built expertise, fit-for-purpose solutions, and supporting technology. weloglobal.com 

The Role 
We are seeking an experienced English into Serbian (Cyrillic) Review Lead to serve as the language quality owner and primary client-facing linguistic expert for a leading global technology client. 
You will own the locale’s interpretation of the client’s quality standards and make sure that the Post-Editing Lead, Post Editors, and Reviewers all work to the same shared understanding of “good”. You will be the main point of contact for the client’s Language Manager on quality discussions, arbitration, and escalations, and you will drive consistency, quality governance, and continuous improvement across UI, marketing, product, informational, legal, and support content. 
Project Details 
- Location: Remote (based in one of the approved countries below)
- Expected volume: Approximately 24 hours per month
- Employment type: Freelance / Independent Contract
- Task type: Language Lead Support
- Content types: UI, Marketing, Informational, Legal, Product, Support
- Language pair: English into Serbian (Cyrillic)
What You Will Do 
-Analyse requirements: Review every style guide and glossary update, assess which quality categories and content types it affects, and record the changes. Track what the client’s Language Manager actually corrects and says in calibration and quality calls, not only what is written down.
-Relay expectations: Run regular alignment roundtables with the language community and publish a structured monthly quality digest covering performance, priority improvement areas, style guide updates, and notable errors and arbitration outcomes.
-Manage review quality actively: Coach Reviewers one-to-one using specific examples, run shadowing sessions built from real alignment data.
-Improve the standard: Turn recurring justification patterns into well-reasoned style guide proposals, and share cross-locale patterns with the Welocalize Quality Manager.
-Maintain alignment with the client: Treat Language Manager decisions as the standard, raise concerns with evidence at the right forum, and aim for fewer surprises over time.
What You Will Own
-The locale’s review service score, including RQE audit and alignment performance
-The community’s shared understanding of quality 
-The integrity of the arbitration record, ensuring that every arbitration sent to the client is valid and well-evidenced
-The working relationship with the client’s Language Manager, including clarifications, escalations, and expectation tracking
Requirements
- Experience: 3 to 5+ years in Localization Quality Assurance (LQA), Senior Language Lead, or Quality Governance roles
- Client and stakeholder management: Direct experience as the primary point of contact for client Language Managers, managing formal arbitration or escalation processes, and facilitating conflict resolution
- Quality audit frameworks: Deep, practical experience with localization evaluation frameworks, including RQE, LQE, error rubrics, and severity mapping

title: Instrumentation and Controls Engineer
description:
Thanks for your interest in Oklo ! We are searching for an Instrumentation and Controls Engineer to join our engineering team.

Position Description:

The Instrumentation and Controls Engineer is responsible for developing, analyzing, and integrating measurement and control systems to support reactor operation. This position may reside within powerhouse engineering supporting power generation or within the isotopes organization supporting isotope reactors.

Specific responsibilities may include:

• Design instrumentation and control systems that integrate sensors, instrumentation, actuators, and other control components

• Lead the technical execution of assigned systems as a responsible engineer that coordinates requirements, design, testing, and commissioning

• Experience managing, communicating with, and providing oversight to EPC contractors, vendors, and equipment manufacturers

And working at Gainwell carries its rewards. You’ll have an incredible opportunity to grow your career in a company that values work-life balance, continuous learning, and career development.

Summary

As a Principal Medicaid Pharmacy Strategist, PDL, Pricing & Contracting at Gainwell, you will contribute your pharmacy, Medicaid, analytical, and clinical expertise to support state Medicaid pharmacy programs and the populations they serve. This role supports the development and maintenance of Medicaid Preferred Drug Lists (PDLs), clinical coverage criteria, drug cost analyses, and supplemental rebate strategies.

The ideal candidate will be a pharmacist with extensive knowledge of Medicaid pharmacy operations, including drug pricing methodologies, supplemental rebate programs, Medicaid Drug Rebate Program concepts, clinical criteria development, and pharmacy point-of-sale (POS) claims processing. This position requires a strong ability to translate complex clinical, utilization, pricing, and rebate data into actionable recommendations for Medicaid clients.

Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and the ability to independently analyze large and complex pharmacy datasets are essential to success in this role.

Your role in our mission

• Support Medicaid Preferred Drug List (PDL) strategy through analysis of drug products, clinical criteria, utilization, pricing, and rebate opportunities.

• Conduct financial analyses using drug pricing, utilization, and Medicaid rebate data to support formulary and coverage recommendations.

• Evaluate clinical criteria, prior authorizations, and pharmacy benefit requirements to optimize access, cost, and rebate outcomes.

• Analyze utilization, expenditures, pricing trends, and supplemental rebate offers to develop client recommendations.

• Build reports, forecasts, and analytical models using advanced Excel and large datasets.

• Present findings to clients and committees, translating complex clinical and financial data into actionable recommendations.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement PDL, rebate, and pharmacy program strategies.

• Monitor market developments, validate program data, and maintain accurate analytical documentation.

What we're looking for

• Licensed Pharmacist (RPh or PharmD) in the U.S.

• 5+ years of pharmacy experience, including Medicaid pharmacy, managed care, PBM operations, formulary management, or related areas.

• Strong knowledge of Medicaid pharmacy programs, including PDLs, utilization management, prior authorization, claims adjudication, and pharmacy benefit operations.

• Experience with drug pricing, Medicaid rebates, supplemental rebates, pharmaceutical contracting, and financial analysis.

• Experience developing or evaluating formularies, PDLs, prior authorization, and utilization management criteria.

• Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including analysis of large datasets and financial modeling.

• Ability to translate clinical, pricing, utilization, and rebate data into sound pharmacy benefit recommendations.

• Preferred: Experience supporting state Medicaid PDL programs, Medicaid supplemental rebate programs, rebate pools, or multi-state contracting initiatives.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with experience identifying and reconciling data discrepancies across multiple sources.

What you should expect in this role

• 100% Remote (U.S. only)

• Travel: Up to 10%

title: (Senior) Strategic Partner Manager (f/m/d)
description:
At Moss, we give finance professionals the power to automate their day-to-day and make forward-thinking decisions.

Our culture is what makes that possible: we play to win, we obsess over quality, and we win as One Moss, and it works. Moss closed a €35 million Series C in August 2026, crossing a €1 billion valuation, and became one of Europe's fintech unicorns. Join us for what's next.

London, UK

Moss is building its strategic partnerships function from scratch, and this is one of the first two hires shaping it. You'll take target platforms from zero relationship to live, revenue-generating integration, owning the sourcing, business case, and delivery for each one.

This is a build phase: you'll define your own playbook rather than follow one. You'll report to the Senior Director Partnerships and work closely with Product and Engineering on integration scope, and with the Channel team where partnerships overlap with existing ERP integrators.

Your responsibilities

- Source and build strategic partnerships from scratch, identifying platforms that fit Moss's customer base and growth priorities

- Navigate complex partner organisations to reach the right decision makers, from founders and C-level contacts at smaller platforms to Heads of Partnerships at larger ones

- Build the commercial and technical case for each partnership and secure buy-in from both Moss leadership and the partner's stakeholders

- Own each partnership end-to-end, from an initial referral or lightweight integration through to a live, revenue-generating relationship

- Partner with Product and Engineering to scope integration requirements and manage delivery against Moss's API and roadmap

- Collaborate with the Channel team where accounting-platform integrators already exist, to avoid overlap and align on commercialisation

- Define and adjust your own playbook, prioritising partners by revenue potential and strategic fit as the market picture sharpens

About you

- 5+ years in business development or partnerships within B2B SaaS, fintech, cloud, or payments

- At least 2 years specifically in strategic partnerships or integration-led partner roles, having built relationships from scratch rather than managed an existing book

- Working knowledge of APIs and how software platforms integrate with external partner systems

In addition, here are the skills and attributes we are looking for:

- Thrives with full ownership of a plan and pipeline, without needing day-to-day direction

- Brings structure to ambiguous, still-being-built processes and partnerships

- Communicates progress, blockers, and trade-offs clearly across product, engineering, and leadership

- Balances ambition with realism, adjusting timelines to partner readiness and internal constraints without losing momentum

About Moss

Moss is the Finance AI platform for Europe's mid-sized businesses, giving companies real-time visibility and full control over their spend. title: Tax Director, Tax Counsel
description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s Tax and Trade team sits at the center of OpenAI’s global growth, shaping how cutting-edge AI products, partnerships, and infrastructure scale across borders while navigating complex tax, trade, and regulatory regimes. We operate as strategic operators, not just compliance experts, embedding early in product, finance, policy, and infrastructure decisions to manage risk, unlock incentives, and enable OpenAI to grow responsibly and competitively worldwide.

About the Role

We’re hiring a Tax Director to advise on OpenAI’s global tax strategy and support the company’s continued international expansion. This role will partner closely with Legal, Finance, Corporate Development, and commercial teams on cross-border tax planning, operating model design, market entry, strategic partnerships, product launches, intercompany arrangements, and complex commercial transactions.

You will bring deep international tax expertise and practical business judgment to help OpenAI move quickly while managing risk across a rapidly evolving global footprint. The role requires someone who can translate complex tax rules into clear recommendations, build scalable frameworks, and operate as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders across the company.

You’ll be responsible for:

- Support tax aspects of strategic transactions, including acquisitions, joint ventures, reorganizations, divestitures, and post-close integration, in partnership with Corporate Development, Legal, and Finance.

- Advise on international tax planning and global operating model design, including legal entity footprint, intercompany arrangements, IP ownership and use, customer contracting models, and cross-border service flows.

- Serve as a core tax business partner for global expansion initiatives, including new market entry, changes in operating footprint, and regional business scaling.

- Advise Product, Legal, Finance, and commercial teams on tax considerations for go-to-market motions, strategic partnerships, customer contracting, and new revenue models.

- Evaluate permanent establishment, withholding tax, treaty, source and character, transfer pricing, and other international tax considerations arising from global business activity.

- Monitor US and international tax law and policy developments, including Pillar Two and other global tax reform initiatives, and assess implications for OpenAI’s business planning and operating model.

- Advise on tax aspects of financing and treasury initiatives, including intercompany funding, capital structure planning, and third-party financings.

- Manage external advisors and coordinate internal stakeholders to deliver timely, practical, and high-quality tax advice across business initiatives.

- Build scalable frameworks, playbooks, and processes that enable consistent, repeatable tax advisory for a fast-growing global business.

- Communicate complex tax issues clearly to non-tax stakeholders, including senior leadership, and help drive decisions that balance tax efficiency, risk management, operational feasibility, and business priorities.

We’re looking for someone with:

- A J.D. and strong academic credentials; LL.M. in Taxation a plus.

- 12+ years of progressive international tax experience, ideally with a mix of law firm and in-house experience at a high-growth multinational business.

- Strong foundation in complex domestic and cross-border M&A, joint ventures, reorganizations, and post-acquisition integrations.

- Extensive experience advising on cross-border commercial arrangements, market entry, strategic partnerships, and international expansion.

- Deep technical expertise in US international tax, including GILTI, FDII, BEAT, foreign tax credits, withholding tax, tax treaties, source and character of income, Subpart F, and permanent establishment principles.

- Strong understanding of transfer pricing principles, intercompany arrangements, IP planning, and global operating model design.

description:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken https://kraken.tech/ powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

🏡 Where you'll fit in

You'll own the commercial negotiation of our largest customer deals end to end. That covers tier-1 SaaS, managed services, and core billing platform deals with regulated utilities and energy retailers. You'll report to the Chief Commercial Officer and carry board-level accountability for deals above $100m.

You'll lead a cross-functional deal team and make sure every seat is filled by the right person:

- Executive sponsor and deal owner: holds the mandate on our side, approves the commercial envelope, and breaks deadlocks fast.

- Lead negotiator: runs the table, controls pacing and concessions, and stays separate from the delivery owner. This is the seat you'll usually hold.

- Pricing and deal economics lead: builds the deal model and covers pricing structures, margin, cash flow, and cost to serve.

- Legal and contracts counsel: covers liability caps, intellectual property (IP) ownership, indemnities, termination, data protection, and the exit terms we can accept.

- Solution architect and delivery lead: tests feasibility, scope, service levels (SLAs), and migration plans, and signs off what we can commit to.

- Sales and account lead: owns the customer relationship, the pursuit plan, and executive sponsorship on the customer side.

- Finance: covers payment terms, currency and indexation, revenue recognition, and approval thresholds.

- Risk, security, and compliance: handles regulatory, data residency, and resilience requirements.

- Lead negotiation of multi-year SaaS, core billing, and managed services agreements worth $250m to $1bn+ in total contract value, from proposal through signature.

- Set the commercial playbook: pricing architecture, walk-away positions, a concession log, and fallback positions on liability, service levels, and exit.

- Agree one position before you sit down. Rank priorities as must-have, trade, or give, and define your walk-away point (your best alternative to a negotiated agreement, or BATNA).

- Structure deals that fit the risk and protect our margin: per-account bands, volume tiers, indexation, and price-down glide paths, with clear limits on how far we'll go.

- Decide which risks to accept, share, or refuse, and put a price on each one.

- Negotiate core billing and Customer Information System (CIS) replacements, including migration plans, regulatory change, service levels, and exit terms.

- Define scope precisely: baseline, assumptions, dependencies, and exclusions. Most disputes start here, so you'll settle them before signature.

- Set tiered deal-approval thresholds and discount discipline, so concessions on price and liability stay inside policy.

- Shape pursuits with Sales, from capture planning to executive briefings, and build the case to win against incumbent billing vendors.

- Handle the customer's leverage tactics, such as a competing bid, a procurement deadline, or a "sign now" ask, without giving away margin.

- Bring Delivery and Product into the deal early, so scope, migration plans, and roadmap commitments are signed off before contract.

- Protect margin after signature: keep change-order discipline and scope control, and track renewals and expansion alongside the headline price.
